title: Quantum field theory II and gauge theory
prerequisites: G7b; E1 group theory helpful; G5 for scaling analogies.
purpose: Use path integrals, renormalization and gauge symmetry while distinguishing effective theories from ultraviolet claims.

blocks.deliverable: Recover a free field correlation function.
Identify divergent terms with a stated regulator.
Show which quantities depend on scheme and scale.
Week 7 midterm; solve a simple beta function flow.
Explain redundant variables and a gauge condition.
Analyze a simple scalar potential and its symmetry.
State validity limits and complete an advanced field theory final.

project: Work one renormalized one loop toy calculation or derive a simple running coupling equation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
